text_block_list.name: Elementary School Teacher
text_block_list.text: "Shakur is a very bright child.However, she has a hard timeunderstanding that being correctdoesn't always mean she's right..."

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"To be completely honest, the other<n>teachers and I
aren't sure how to<n>deal with her. She's completely
isolated herself from her class. She's<n>even gotten
in a few fights."

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"I swear, we're all doing our best to<n>understand
her, but... unless she<n>starts putting in a little effort to
reciprocate, there's not much more<n>we can do..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry, but she's always been<n>like that. It's
just who she is... You<n>don't have to worry about
her. You'll<n>only provoke her..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (Ever since I was a kid, I've alwaysbeen some sort of enigma to others.No matter what I did, it was wrongbecause I'm wrong.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Whenever people spoke, all I'd hear<n>was noise...
We'd be speaking the<n>same language, but no one
understood what I was saying.<n>Eventually, I gave
up and shut up.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(That's when I discovered<n>computers. It felt like I
was hearing<n>someone speak for the first time.<n>Turns
out programming languages<n>were the only ones I
needed.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(With a partner like that, I could make<n>all the noise
disappear. Around that<n>time is when I found the
most<n>effective way to prove myself—as a<n>student at
Tracen Academy.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I finished Parcae shortly after<n>enrolling, and they
were the perfect<n>partner. The more data I entered,
the<n>more accurate the answer they gave.)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
"Just what is Air Shakur thinking...<n>She doesn't
listen to the teachers, is<n>generally uncooperative,
and can be<n>self-absorbed... But..."

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to run with Shakur at<n>all... It's like
she's from another<n>planet sometimes... It's scary.
But..."

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: "She's winning, so she's clearly<n>skilled."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(...That was the best part. When I won<n>a race,
everyone would shut their<n>mouths, getting rid of the
noise. So I<n>decided to aim even higher.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(If I won more, or better races... Yeah,<n>if I earned a
title only the best of the<n>best receive... If I could
become the<n>Triple Crown champion...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Then maybe, they'd ■■■■■■■■■■ ■■.<n>Or so I
thought...)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After following Air Shakur from her<n>practice, I find
her standing in the<n>courtyard.
choice_data_list: Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's... you again. What do you want?
choice_data_list:
That run you showed off this afternoon was
something else.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah... Huh?
choice_data_list: It's clear you put a lot of work into it.
It's clear you put a lot of work into it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hmph... The hell? Where'd that come<n>from...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is that all you came here to say?<n>If so, good
for you. Now hurry up and<n>get lost.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Of course that's not the only thing. Iwant to see her run more—get toknow her more. I...
choice_data_list: I want to be your trainer!
I want to be your trainer!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it seemed rather sudden,<n>but the moment
I said it, I knew it was<n>true. I've wanted to be her
trainer<n>from the moment we met.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I don't see the logic in this. Ahh, did<n>you fall for
my run or something?<n>Then too bad, I refuse. I
don't have<n>time for baseless proposals.
choice_data_list:
But the basis of our training relationship would be
up to you, no?

But the basis of our training relationship would be
up to you, no?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list:
Why don't you tell me what it is you're running
for?

Why don't you tell me what it is you're running
for?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What good would that information do?<n>If you really
want to be my trainer,<n>write up a proposal based on
my<n>skills or a goal.
choice_data_list: But if I know why you run, I can help you.
But if I know why you run, I can help you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
How? What could you possibly...<n>What makes you
think you'd do a<n>better job than me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Nutrition, sports engineering... I'vememorized countless essays anddata sets. So tell me—how exactly areyou gonna help me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You don't have an answer, do you?Spit it out. Truth is... you just want tobe my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You want to be helpful. You want tobe my savior. But truth is you can'tdo anything.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She throws her rejection in my face...<n>but behind
those harsh words hides<n>the information I want.
I'm not<n>backing down now.
choice_data_list: You're right, I haven't done anything yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: So where's your proof that I can't do it?
So where's your proof that I can't do it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh, for crying out loud. Would you<n>just—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...You know what? Follow me. I'll let<n>the numbers
do the talking.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: This is the answer Parcae lead me to.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Before us lies Air Shakur's precious<n>laptop. On the
screen, I see she's<n>opened up a program of some
sort.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There I see countless equations and
variables—enough to fill the whole<n>screen. And at
the very end, after the<n>equals sign is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's the answer I got the first time I<n>calculated
everything, and it hasn't<n>changed since. By this
calculation...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I will lose the Japanese Derby by<n>seven
centimeters, and with it, I'll<n>lose my shot at the
Triple Crown. End<n>of story.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown refers to three G1<n>races runners
can only tackle in their<n>classic year: the Satsuki
Sho, the<n>Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Racers who win all three are known<n>as Triple
Crown champions. Among<n>thousands of
challengers, only a<n>select few have manage to
snag that<n>title.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I... will never be a Triple Crown<n>champion. No matter
how many times<n>I run the inputs, the answer is
always<n>the same.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And don't try to suggest that the<n>program's off.
Trust me, it's not. I<n>can guarantee that... which
means my<n>loss is also... guaranteed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Do you get it now? Nothing you do<n>can help me. If I
can't fix this... no one<n>can.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I can't truly understand howhopeless her struggle seems, but Ican tell that she's still fighting despite that. And there can only be onereason as to why...
choice_data_list: You still want to win though, right?
You still want to win though, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This is what I wanted to know—her<n>dream. It may
not come off as<n>special—heck, everyone has a
dream—but as long as she has that...
choice_data_list:
As long as you keep that dream in your heart, that
number will change!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If dreams alone could change<n>anything, don't you
think that<n>would've happened already?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I know it's futile, pathetic even... ButI've redone all the calculations againand again and again and again andAGAIN! Nothing changed!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But I run and run... and run more! Just<n>hoping...
someday... But it... it was all<n>useless... And then you
have the<n>nerve...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: To just show up and act like you canchange things! So go ahead... tell mehow it'll be different with you!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur lashes out in anger and<n>despair.
Undoubtedly, her own training<n>is what lead her to
this conclusion,<n>and I won't sit here telling her
she's<n>wrong... but...
choice_data_list: (But I still want my shot!)
(But I still want my shot!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, I think you get the point.<n>And even if you
don't, just leave me<n>alone.
choice_data_list: (...I need to get to know her better.)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She may have rejected my offer this<n>time, but for
some reason, I don't feel<n>like giving up just yet.
